items.quote: Zahlbar 14 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum per Überweisung.
items.computation: Invoice date (start of period) is 21.11.2026 (Saturday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event is not counted, so the 14-day period starts on 22.11.2026. Counting 14 days (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB) the period ends on 05.12.2026. 21.11.2026 is a Saturday, so 14 days later (two full weeks) 05.12.2026 is also a Saturday. This is a private payment owed to a company; under § 193 BGB, since the last day falls on a Saturday, the deadline moves to the next working day. 06.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the next working day is Monday 07.12.2026.
